// Adds the uuid box Canon cameras write in moov to an MP4 made by ffmpeg
// (whose moov is last, so no chunk offset moves): as moov's first child,
// with a version (CNCV), CNDM, and CNTH holding the thumbnail JPEG (CNDA)
// and then padding that isn't boxes, up to CNTH's size. moov's size
// grows by the box's.
//
// Usage: go run canon.go <in.mp4> <thumbnail.jpg> <out.mp4>
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/binary"
	"os"
)

func box(typ string, parts ...[]byte) []byte {
	body := bytes.Join(parts, nil)
	return append(binary.BigEndian.AppendUint32(nil, uint32(8+len(body))), append([]byte(typ), body...)...)
}

func main() {
	in, _ := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	thumb, _ := os.ReadFile(os.Args[2])
	cnda := box("CNDA", thumb)
	// The padding: bytes after CNDA that a box walker would misread (a
	// size past CNTH's end).
	pad := make([]byte, 4096-len(cnda)%4096)
	copy(pad, []byte{0x00, 0x10, 0x00, 0x00, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff})
	uuid := box("uuid",
		[]byte{0x85, 0xc0, 0xb6, 0x87, 0x82, 0x0f, 0x11, 0xe0, 0x81, 0x11, 0xf4, 0xce, 0x46, 0x2b, 0x6a, 0x48},
		box("CNCV", []byte("CanonMP4_002/01.00.00/00.00.00")),
		box("CNDM", []byte{0xff, 0xd8, 0xff, 0xd9}),
		box("CNTH", cnda, pad))
	// The top-level moov box.
	at := 0
	for at+8 <= len(in) && string(in[at+4:at+8]) != "moov" {
		at += int(binary.BigEndian.Uint32(in[at:]))
	}
	if at+8 > len(in) {
		panic("no moov")
	}
	n := binary.BigEndian.Uint32(in[at:])
	out := append([]byte(nil), in[:at+8]...)
	out = append(out, uuid...)
	out = append(out, in[at+8:]...)
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(out[at:], n+uint32(len(uuid)))
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Args[3], out, 0o644); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
